name: experiments
description: Experiment protocol (W037, the W035/W036 flat source-exported package pattern): the DECLARATIVE experiment descriptor — world definition references, participant specs, the W036 §13 evaluation policy, the reward model, the constraint set — with deterministic identity (a canonical hash over the descriptor: same descriptor bytes → same experiment id, A9); and the experiment manifest — which trajectory records belong to the experiment, the holdout split assignments per the policy's holdout kinds (periods/regimes/assets/venues walk-forward splits as DATA — declarative split descriptors, never computed statistics), and the integrity requirements carried forward. Fail-closed: unknown holdout kinds, malformed descriptors, reward models that fail W036's construction laws, and trajectory/experiment scope mismatches are loud typed errors naming the law. A CONTRACT package: NO execution — the world runtime runs sessions (W035), W038 walks what this defines.
